_doc: Prompts for this channel's music library (Drive Music-Library/blueprint/). Generate with scripts/lyria_music.py; PLAYBOOK §12.1.
common: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no humming, no spoken words, no vocal samples, and no pads or synths that sound like voices or a choir: sustained sounds come from bowed strings, piano, electric piano, organ-free analogue synths and electronic hum. This is a documentary underscore that plays under a narrator's voice: no lead melody in the speech range, no sudden loud hits or long silences, a steady overall level from start to finish, clean cinematic mix, wide stereo. Make it about three minutes long. It ends with a final held chord or note that decays naturally, never an abrupt cut.

tracks.title: Curious Pulse
tracks.use: Act 1, the broken intuition and the first test
tracks.prompt: Curious, precise and intelligent. 96 BPM, A minor. A light steady pulse of soft plucked synth and muted marimba in eighth notes, a warm soft pad underneath, a gentle sub-bass on the downbeats. Minimal and clean like a scientist at a drawing board. No big melody, no drums beyond a very soft tick. Small changes every 20 seconds keep it alive.
tracks.brief: curious, precise, light steady pulse, soft pad, no big melody

tracks.title: Clockwork Mechanism
tracks.use: A mechanism explained step by step, exploded parts, gears meshing
tracks.prompt: Methodical and intricate. 110 BPM, D major / B minor. Interlocking minimalist arpeggios on celesta, plucked strings and a clean electric piano, like gears meshing; each layer enters one at a time and locks into the others. Light ticking percussion like a fine clock. Feels like watching a mechanism work perfectly.
tracks.brief: methodical interlocking minimalist arpeggios, clockwork, bright

tracks.title: Under Load
tracks.use: Act 2, the doubt: forces build, the intuition fails
tracks.prompt: Darker tension, restrained, not horror. 84 BPM, C minor. Low cello and bass ostinato, a pulsing analogue synth bass, soft metallic textures and a faint clock-like tick. Slowly builds over three minutes by adding layers, never loud. Feels like a structure under rising load.
tracks.brief: dark restrained tension, low strings and synth pulse, slowly building, not horror

tracks.title: Stress Field
tracks.use: The run-up to a failure: the stress climbs to the notch
tracks.prompt: Rising, driving tension. 120 BPM, E minor. Staccato string ostinato in sixteenths, a deep synth pulse, taiko-like low drums very soft and distant, metallic swells. Builds steadily in intensity from quiet to strong over the piece, then pulls back to a held low note at the end. Precise, engineered, not chaotic.
tracks.brief: rising driving tension, staccato strings, deep pulse, builds then pulls back

tracks.title: The Answer
tracks.use: Act 3, the paradox solved: building, then warm and resolved
tracks.prompt: Building, then warm and resolved. 90 BPM, F major. Starts with a quiet piano and soft pulse, adds strings and a gentle synth arpeggio, grows to a warm, satisfying full sound around the middle like a puzzle clicking into place, then settles into calm resolved chords and ends gently.
tracks.brief: builds then warm and resolved, ends gently, satisfying

tracks.title: Inside the Crystal
tracks.use: 3D reveals, microscopic worlds, slow camera moves through a machine
tracks.prompt: Slow wonder. 70 BPM, E major with suspended chords. Glassy shimmering pads, bowed vibraphone, soft harp arpeggios, a deep warm drone. Spacious and luminous, like seeing the inside of a metal crystal for the first time. No percussion.
tracks.brief: slow wonder, glassy shimmering pads, spacious, no percussion

tracks.title: Furnace
tracks.use: Heat, friction, high temperature, electrical stress
tracks.prompt: Industrial heat. 75 BPM, G minor. A low electric hum like a transformer, deep bowed double basses, slow metallic percussion hits on a steady grid, a gritty analogue synth bass line, distant machine rhythm. Hot, dense and heavy but controlled and steady in level, cinematic.
tracks.brief: industrial hot hum, metallic percussion, low strings, heavy, steady, controlled

tracks.title: Laminar
tracks.use: Fluids, air flow, boundary layers, anything that flows
tracks.prompt: Fluid and flowing. 88 BPM, D major. Rippling piano and harp arpeggios that flow like water, soft string pads, a gentle rolling pulse. Smooth, continuous, curious, with small eddies of counter-melody in the low register.
tracks.brief: fluid flowing arpeggios, smooth, continuous, curious

tracks.title: Tolerance
tracks.use: Measurements, numbers, data and telemetry on screen
tracks.prompt: Clean, focused, modern. 100 BPM, B minor. A tight electronic pulse, soft muted kick, crisp hi-hat ticks very low, a synth bass line and sparse electric piano chords. Feels like precise measurement and telemetry, calm and confident.
tracks.brief: clean focused modern electronic pulse, calm, confident

tracks.title: Landing
tracks.use: The outro, the landing image and the forward line
tracks.prompt: Calm and reflective, forward-looking. 80 BPM, C major. Soft piano chords, a warm string pad, a gentle slow arpeggio. A quiet sense of understanding and a hint of the next question. Simple and resolved, ends on a soft held major chord.
tracks.brief: calm reflective forward-looking, soft piano and strings, resolved ending

tracks.title: Shorts Hook
tracks.use: Vertical Shorts: an instant hook and a fast reveal
tracks.prompt: Make this one about one minute long. Starts immediately at full energy with no intro: a punchy curious pulse of plucked synth, deep bass and a tight soft beat, 118 BPM, A minor. A small lift at thirty seconds, then a clean ending on a held note.
tracks.brief: punchy curious immediate start, about one minute, tight beat
